title: Citius Pharmaceuticals Announces the Closing of Registered Direct Offering of $6.0 Million Priced At-The-Market Under Nasdaq Rules
summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Nasdaq: CTXR) ("Citius Pharma" or the "Company"), a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the development and commercialization of first-in-class critical care products, today announced the closing of its previously announced registered direct offering priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules for the purchase of an aggregate of 3,973,510 shares of its common stock (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof) and accompanying common warrants to purchase up to an aggregate of 3,973,510 shares of its common stock, at a purchase price of $1.51 per share (or pre-funded warrant in lieu thereof) and accompanying common warrant. The common warrants have an exercise price of $1.40 per share, are exercisable immediately upon issuance, and will expire five years from the initial exercise date. H.C. Wainwright Co. acted as the exclusive placement agent for the offering. The aggregate gross proceeds to the Company from the offering were approximately $6.0 million,
